2610.04303.title: What to Preserve in Recursive Computation: A Local Predictive Sufficiency Principle
2610.04303.paper_summary: Recursive computation repeatedly compresses or reuses intermediate states, creating a simple tension: information that must remain useful across longer recursive paths is also exposed to more opportunities for loss before reaching the final prediction. Existing reconstruction or local-prediction objectives provide tractable supervision, but do not ensure that the retained information remains sufficient for subsequent recursive computation. We identify local predictive sufficiency with recursive predictive closure: controlling local predictive deficiencies at individual interfaces controls the resulting discrepancy at the root. We then turn this principle into a tractable training procedure. Starting from a variational characterization, we derive finite predictive tests and an empirical predictive deficiency that measures predictive value retained across compression. Its predictive sensitivities define margin-relaxed half-space constraints on parameter updates, and we project the host optimizer's proposed update onto their intersection only when predictive preservation would otherwise be violated. Across temporal graphs, language memory, vision-language-action control, and recursive self-improvement, the method matches or improves the corresponding host models under matched compression budgets, with larger gains under heavier recursive or memory demands, while better preserving predictive information across successive transformations. Crucially, the same task-agnostic predictive-preservation principle is instantiated across all four settings through host-compatible interventions while keeping the endpoint task, backbone, and evaluation protocol fixed. These results establish predictive preservation at recursive interfaces as a general training principle for recursive compression.
2610.04303.paper_summary_zh: 遞歸計算重複壓縮或重用中間狀態，產生一個簡單的緊張關係：必須在更長的遞歸路徑中保持有用的信息也面臨著在達到最終預測之前更多的損失機會。現有的重建或局部預測目標提供了可行的監督，但並不確保保留的信息對後續的遞歸計算仍然足夠。我們將局部預測的充分性與遞歸預測的閉合性相結合：控制個別介面的局部預測缺陷可以控制根部的最終差異。我們然後將這一原則轉化為可行的訓練程序。從變分特徵開始，我們推導出有限的預測測試和一個經驗預測缺陷，該缺陷衡量在壓縮過程中保留的預測價值。其預測敏感性定義了對參數更新的邊際放鬆半空間約束，並且我們僅在預測保護否則會被違反的情況下，將主優化器提出的更新投影到它們的交集上。在時間圖、語言記憶、視覺-語言-行動控制和遞歸自我改進中，該方法在匹配的壓縮預算下，與相應的主模型相匹配或改進，在更高的遞歸或記憶需求下獲得更大的增益，同時在連續變換中更好地保留預測信息。關鍵是，這一任務無關的預測保護原則在所有四個設置中都通過與主機兼容的干預得以實現，同時保持最終任務、骨幹和評估協議不變。這些結果確立了在遞歸介面上進行預測保護作為遞歸壓縮的一個通用訓練原則。
